title: Chaos Pack
description: Hostile mobs get a serious upgrade: armored zombies, homing-arrow skeletons, flying spiders, teleporting endermen, and explosive creepers, all running automatically. For 1.21.7-1.21.11.
body:

CHAOS PACK is a datapack that completely transforms how hostile mobs behave in Minecraft. Every enemy you encounter has been upgraded to be stronger, faster, and more dangerous. There are no command blocks to set up and no configuration needed. Install the pack, reload, and the chaos begins immediately.


DIAMOND ZOMBIES

Every zombie that spawns will be equipped with a full set of diamond armor and a diamond sword. On top of that, their movement speed has been significantly increased, making them much harder to outrun than normal zombies. Do not underestimate them just because they look familiar.


SNIPER SKELETONS

Skeletons are no longer the easy targets they used to be. Every skeleton spawns wearing a netherite helmet and carrying a bow enchanted with Power V, Punch II, Infinity, and Flame. Their body constantly rotates to track the nearest player, and every arrow they fire will curve and home in on you mid-flight. There is almost no way to dodge.


FLYING SPIDERS

Spiders in this pack are no longer limited to the ground. They have no gravity and will fly directly toward you from any direction, including from above. Combined with their speed boost, they are one of the most unpredictable threats in the pack.


AGGRESSIVE ENDERMEN

Endermen in this pack are faster and far more aggressive. When a player is nearby, they will close the distance quickly and occasionally blink forward in short bursts, making them feel erratic and hard to deal with.


MEGA CREEPERS

Every creeper now carries an explosion radius equivalent to a vanilla charged creeper. If one happens to be struck by lightning and becomes a charged creeper on top of that, the explosion doubles again, resulting in a blast twice as large as anything you have seen from a charged creeper before.


HOW IT WORKS

The pack runs entirely through a tick function that executes every game tick. A tag system ensures that gear and stat changes are only applied once per mob the moment it spawns, so performance stays clean even with large numbers of enemies nearby. No command blocks, no setup, no manual work required.


INSTALLATION

Download the zip file and do not extract it. Place it directly into the datapacks folder inside your world save folder. The path is .minecraft then saves then your world name then datapacks. Open the world or run the reload command. If you see the CHAOS PACK banner appear in chat, the pack is active and working.


COMPATIBILITY

Built and tested for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11.
